minor.issue: Returns 401 on anonymous pageview (pre-known from iter56/57, harmless console noise).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL — page renders entirely blank. Uncaught runtime error 'ReferenceError: WC_FAQS is not defined' thrown from line 54 (<FAQSchemaScript faqs={WC_FAQS} />) and line 352 (<EventFAQ faqs={WC_FAQS} />). The variable WC_FAQS is never declared, imported, or defined anywhere in the file. This is a regression: in iter57 the page rendered hero+events but lacked JSON-LD; now it is fully broken. Likely caused by main agent attempting to add FAQ JSON-LD without also defining the WC_FAQS constant (e.g., expected `const WC_FAQS = [...]`).

New /concerts-in-paris-2026 route not listed in any sub-sitemap. Same is true for /concerts-in-london-2026 and /concerts-in-amsterdam-2026 (pre-existing). If these pages should be indexed, add them to a sitemap (cities.xml or concerts.xml).

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL, NEW REGRESSION): WorldCupLandingPage.jsx lines 54 + 352 — declare/import the missing WC_FAQS constant (array of {question, answer} objects). Without it, the entire /world-cup-2026-tickets page is a white-screen crash. Highest priority because this URL is the primary World Cup landing page.

FIX (MEDIUM): Add /concerts-in-paris-2026 (and /concerts-in-london-2026, /concerts-in-amsterdam-2026) to the appropriate sub-sitemap so they are discoverable by Googlebot. Likely belongs in cities.xml or concerts.xml in the backend sitemap generator.

VERIFIED (no action needed): DOM nesting (<span> child of <tr>/<tbody>) fix in babel-metadata-plugin.js — works on all 5 originally-failing routes. ConcertsParis2026Page renders cleanly with full content, JSON-LD, and matches London/Amsterdam pattern.
critical_code_review_comments: WC_FAQS bug indicates missing pre-commit/CI lint check. ESLint with `no-undef` rule (default in eslint:recommended) would have caught this before merge. Recommend adding a `yarn lint` step to CI gating PR merges.

babel-metadata-plugin.js NO_SPAN_CHILD_ELEMENTS exclusion list now spans 18+ tags (table/tbody/tr/thead/tfoot/colgroup/script/style/title/textarea/noscript/select/optgroup/datalist/ul/ol/dl/menu/picture/video/audio/math/svg). Recommend adding a unit test against this list so future regressions (e.g., someone removing 'script' to test something) are caught immediately.

Sitemap appears to be hand-maintained per category — new SEO landing pages like /concerts-in-{city}-2026 are not auto-discovered. Consider a route registry that the sitemap generator reads from so adding a new React route automatically adds it to the sitemap.

rca of the issue: WorldCupLandingPage.jsx references WC_FAQS in two locations (line 54 inside <FAQSchemaScript> and line 352 inside <EventFAQ>) but never defines or imports it. Most likely the main agent imported FAQSchemaScript+EventFAQ from ../components/EventFAQ (line 10) and added the JSX usages but forgot to also declare `const WC_FAQS = [{question, answer}, ...]` near the top of the file. Reproduction: `curl -s https://euro-indexing.preview.emergentagent.com/world-cup-2026-tickets | grep -i 'world cup'` returns the title from pre-hydration but a Playwright headless browser shows the full-page Uncaught error overlay 'WC_FAQS is not defined' at WorldCupLandingPage. Mitigation: add the missing constant declaration (e.g., `const WC_FAQS = [{question: 'When is the 2026 World Cup?', answer: '...'}, ...]`) before its first use in the component.
